pairs.why: Nearly identical clocks; A sits smaller in a lit backdrop with a floor glow and a soft cast shadow, which matches the staging of the real vending machine and phone box better than B's flat, cropped green.
Same pair as q008 with the sides swapped: B has the gradient backdrop with a floor and a grounded shadow like the real cards, while A is bigger and flatter.
Almost the same image; A's candle throws a warm glow onto the sill, closer to the warm-lit windows of the real cards, while B's light stays contained.
Same pair as q010 again: A has the warm candle light spilling onto the sill, and B is otherwise identical but a little flatter.
A's dense cobblestone floor is the over-textured look the lessons penalize; B's smooth, large flagstones, warm light pool and gold trim match the real cards' softer painted finish.
Same pair as q012 swapped: A has the smoother flagstones and warm glow like the real cards, while B's busy cobblestones are too texture-heavy.
